items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: Like the drummer for Aretha Franklin, Bernard Purdie

ctx.x: There were egos but not in the sense that your question is saying. You do this part because I can do it better, it was never anything like that. And if I was playing something the other musicians — I’m not saying Kenny wasn’t always on it, sometimes I was the

only guy on it. And if they liked what I played okay. If they didn’t like what I played try this, I’ll try this. So egos would only get in the way. There were a lot of guys that had different kinds of egos. Like the drummer for Aretha Franklin, Bernard Purdie —
